race.comment: VINO MISS (10) only had one run last campaign when thrown into the deep end of an Open 3YO Saturday race. The form out of that worked out nicely, and she comes back to a maiden on resumption with Fiore booked. Should get every chance from the draw and a forward showing is anticipated. HOT CHIX LANE (9) was solid at this track and trip in her only run last campaign. Pike hops on board for her return today and that's a positive sign as she hasn't trialled publicly coming in. Drawn out, but has early speed and she can play a leading role. DREAMS OF DIAMONDS (8) was no match for an impressive winner here last time out, missing by 4.5L. She's building nicely into the campaign and is ready to go one better now. Can land the knockout blow. BUBBLES IN RIO (4) has enough speed to roll across from out wide and can't be left out of calculations. BUDINO (11) won't be far away on debut with the aid of an inside barrier.
